faq.q: How do I install Snapchat on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Snapchat and check the developer is Snap Inc before tapping Install. It needs Android 6.0 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically, so you never need to download an APK by hand. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Snap Inc and may be altered, so the safest way to use Snapchat is the official listing.

Yes. Snapchat is free to download and use, and it's funded by ads in Stories and Spotlight. Snapchat+ is an optional paid subscription that adds extra features and early access to new ones. Google Play lists in-app purchases from $0.49 to $399.99.

faq.q: How do I turn off my location on Snap Map?
faq.a: Open the Snap Map by pinching the camera screen, tap the settings gear, and turn on Ghost Mode. Your location is then hidden from friends. You can also choose to share it only with selected friends instead of all of them.

By default, Snaps disappear after they're opened and chats disappear after they've been viewed, depending on your chat settings. But anyone can take a screenshot or photo of their screen. Snapchat tells you when someone screenshots, but it can't stop it, so don't send anything you wouldn't want kept.

Snapchat is rated Teen on Google Play and requires users to be at least 13. Teen accounts have stricter defaults, such as limits on who can contact them. Parents can use Family Center to see who their teen is talking to, without seeing the messages themselves.
